info.title: OMA LwM2M Neighbour Cell Report (Object ID 10247)

Neighbour_Cell_Report.label: Neighbour Cell Report
Neighbour_Cell_Report.description: This LWM2M Object provides the neighbour cell report. The CrowdBox Measurements Object and the Connected UE Report Object have both Objlnk Resources pointing to this Object.

Neighbour_PCI.label: Neighbour PCI
Neighbour_PCI.description: Physical Cell ID of neighbouring LTE cell, as defined in TS 36.211

Neighbour_Cell_ID.label: Neighbour Cell ID
Neighbour_Cell_ID.description: Neighbour cell ID as specified by the cellIdentity field broadcast in SIB1 of the neighbour cell (see TS 36.331).

Neighbour_Cell_Rank.label: Neighbour Cell Rank
Neighbour_Cell_Rank.description: Current neighbour cell rank. Neighbour cells should be ordered (ranked) by the CrowdBox according to neighbour cell RSRP, with a higher RSRP corresponding to a lower index. Hence the neighbouring cell with the highest RSRP should be neighbour cell 0, the second neighbour cell 1, and so on.

Neighbour_Cell_RSRP.label: Neighbour Cell RSRP
Neighbour_Cell_RSRP.description: Neighbour cell RSRP, as defined in TS 36.133, Section 9.1.4. Range: RSRP_00; RSRP_01 .. RSRP_97

Neighbour_Cell_RSRQ.label: Neighbour Cell RSRQ
Neighbour_Cell_RSRQ.description: Neighbour cell RSRQ, as defined in TS 36.133, Section 9.1.7. Range: RSRQ_-30; RSRQ_-29 .. RSRQ_46
